strings.tutorial.speedlink.01: Move both ways with the joystick.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.02: Move close and hit with the left small button.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.03: Hit with the right small button.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.04: Land two hits with the left large button.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.05: Press the right large button three times to roll forward.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.06: Hold away and press the right large button three times to roll backward.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.07: Hold down and press the right large button to sweep the legs.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.08: Hold up and press the right large button for a high kick.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.09: Hold both large buttons to block.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.10: Hold down and both large buttons to block low.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.11: Hold up and press the left large button for a jump kick.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.12: Hold away and press the left large button for a spinning round kick.
strings.tutorial.speedlink.13: Press the right small and right large buttons together to dodge backward.

strings.tutorial.01.title: 01 • FOOTWORK FIRST
strings.tutorial.01.instruction: Walk both ways with the left stick or D-pad.
strings.tutorial.01.hint: Balance and distance are the foundation of every technique.
strings.tutorial.02.title: 02 • THE QUICK PUNCH
strings.tutorial.02.instruction: Move close and hit the opponent with X.
strings.tutorial.02.hint: X is quick, but has less reach than a kick.
strings.tutorial.03.title: 03 • STRAIGHT PUNCH
strings.tutorial.03.instruction: Land a gyaku zuki with Y.
strings.tutorial.03.hint: The punch is stronger, but takes longer to prepare.
strings.tutorial.04.title: 04 • FRONT KICK
strings.tutorial.04.hint: Wait until the foot returns before kicking again.
strings.tutorial.05.title: 05 • FORWARD ROLL
strings.tutorial.05.instruction: Press B three times to roll forward.
strings.tutorial.05.hint: You duck under high attacks during the roll. Low kicks still hit.
strings.tutorial.06.title: 06 • BACK ROLL
strings.tutorial.06.instruction: Hold away and press B three times.
strings.tutorial.06.hint: Roll away from the opponent to quickly create distance.
strings.tutorial.07.title: 07 • LEG SWEEP
strings.tutorial.07.instruction: Hold down and press B or RB to sweep the legs.
strings.tutorial.07.hint: The sweep passes under a standing guard.
strings.tutorial.08.title: 08 • HIGH KICK
strings.tutorial.08.instruction: Hold up and press B for a high kick.
strings.tutorial.08.hint: A powerful technique that costs plenty of stamina.
strings.tutorial.09.title: 09 • GUARD THE UPPER BODY
strings.tutorial.09.instruction: Hold LB and block the opponent's front kicks.
strings.tutorial.09.hint: A standing guard protects the head and body.
strings.tutorial.10.title: 10 • GUARD THE LEGS
strings.tutorial.10.instruction: Hold down + LB and block a leg sweep.
strings.tutorial.10.hint: Low guard protects the legs. Normal guard does not.
strings.tutorial.11.title: 11 • JUMP KICK
strings.tutorial.11.instruction: Press RT and land a tobi geri.
strings.tutorial.11.hint: Press direction and kick together, before the jump begins.
strings.tutorial.12.title: 12 • SPINNING ROUND KICK
strings.tutorial.12.instruction: Land a hit with RB without holding down.
strings.tutorial.12.hint: Long reach, but a long preparation and recovery.
strings.tutorial.13.title: 13 • EVADE AND RETURN
strings.tutorial.13.instruction: Use LT three times to slide backward.
strings.tutorial.13.hint: The dodge has a short window where you cannot be hit.
